sprint: World-Owned Text Style — Underline + Strikethrough, Folded Into the Same Row
task: A direct, two-part follow-up on the just-shipped Text object build: 'why we dont have underline as a style , and strikethrough also' followed by an explicit go-ahead, 'ok lets add it in the styles.' The old Style row was a single-select, radio-style control (Normal/Italic), architecturally unable to combine Underline/Strikethrough alongside Italic. Fix: a new _makeMultiToggleRow() in js/contextPanel.js -- a genuine multi-select sibling of _makeIconChoiceRow, each button toggling its own boolean independently -- replaces the Style row's construction with three buttons (I/U/S), each glyph styled to actually look like what it does. Italic keeps riding the existing fontStyle field; Underline/Strikethrough are two new boolean fields on the same elementOverrides bag, written through the already-generic SceneEngine.setContentOverride (true or cleared, never stored as false, matching the null-clears convention). Canvas has no native text-decoration -- renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawText gained real, manually-drawn stroke lines inside its per-line loop, spanning only that line's own measured width, with baseline position approximated per vAlign using standard font-metric ratios, riding on the function's own pre-existing save/restore transform block so Rotation/Opacity apply automatically. Verified via a Playwright test whose own sampling technique needed two real corrections before it could trust its results: a loose darkness threshold wrongly counted the test theme's own dark-navy wall-tone fallback as text, and sampling while an object was SELECTED returned the gold selection-outline colour instead of real content -- both fixed (tighter near-black threshold; deselect before every pixel check) before a delta-scan technique confirmed both strokes render correctly, independently toggle, and coexist when combined with Italic. 19/19 new assertions plus full regression across 11 existing suites and both goldenBuild.js suites all pass unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder change; confined to js/contextPanel.js, renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/sceneEngine.js, and css/style.css.
